University of Queensland MBA Student Scholarship - International 2022 is an initiative by the University of Queensland for MBA aspirants. All interested candidates who have received an unconditional offer for the MBA program are eligible to apply. The selected scholars will receive a tuition fee waiver of 25%.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Have offered a place in MBA program (or GCBA/GDipBA articulation pathway to the MBA)
The selected scholars will receive a tuition fee waiver of 25%.
A video (5 minutes max) that tells the scholarship panel:
about the applicant's motivations for choosing to study for an MBA degree and their career aspirations
about a time the applicant overcame a professional or personal obstacle
what the applicants have done to make their work environment or their community a better place
The applicant's CV and reference documents can be the same ones they use for the program application.
The documents must be uploaded in Word doc/docx, OpenOffice odt or Adobe pdf format
Eligible candidates can apply for the scholarship by following the steps mentioned below -
button and read the details carefully.
Fill in the required details, upload the required documents and submit it.
The selection of the candidates will be made on the basis of academic merit, managerial experience or community involvement, and personal statement responses.
All scholarships are awarded at the discretion of the MBA Director, whose decision is final. Not every scholarship will be awarded annually.
Scholarship deferrals to future semesters are not permitted.
Scholarships will not be extended beyond the 24-month timeframe.
